title: Snazzie FM News: The Counter Is Now Serving
description: The news desk follows a D M V now-serving board that keeps counting down, GreenFlow's all-green grid, and Frank's newly unionized pigeons. Calm. Professional. Counting backward.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Top of the hour. I'm Dale Crisp.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And I'm Marsha Veld. Our top story, the D M V issued ticket A zero zero one this morning.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: The now serving board reads negative fourteen, Marsha. It has not advanced all day.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: We'll stay on that. In transit, GreenFlow's grid turned every light green at once on Route 9.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Officials call it the best commute on record. The four buses on it have not been heard from since.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: No word on the buses. The board, Dale, is still negative fourteen.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Still negative fourteen. Elsewhere, Frank's pigeons have unionized the curb outside.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: They're issuing their own parking citations. The city cannot overrule them.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: And finally, a local note. <p:0.3> The man holding ticket A zero zero one has waited so long the fog offered to cover his rent.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: He declined. <p:0.3> The fog is now also in line, Dale.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: And being served before him. <p:0.3> The board now reads negative fifteen. We'll be right back.
